name: LAC VACCINUM DEFLORATUM
key_symptoms: Despondent. Pain begins in forehead to occiput, in morning on rising. Intense throbbing, with nausea, vomiting, blindness, and obstinate constipation; worse, noise, light, motion, during menses, with great prostration, and better by pressure and bandaging head tightly.

gi_symptoms: Constipation. Stools hard, large, with great straining; painful, lacerating anus.
